paragraph: I need to talk to the doctor **immediately**. I'll bring you the bill **immediately**. She **immediately** went to the kitchen.
english: in an immediate manner
arabicDesc: مثال: عليّ أن أتحدّث مع الطّبيب فورا.

paragraph: His letters become less **significant**. Her family is a **significant** part of her life. What do you like best about your **significant** other?
english: signifying something
arabicDesc: مثال: رسائلهُ أصبحت أقل أهمية.

paragraph: I couldn't get any food **unless** it was brought to me. Don't come **unless** I tell you to. People don't lie **unless** they got something to hide.
english: except on a specified condition
arabicDesc: مثال: لم يكن باستطاعتي الحصول على أيّ طعام إن لم يُحضر لي.

paragraph: Can you **identify** the man using this picture? I don't want to **identify** myself with that group. I wish you would **identify** as an original joke.
english: to recognize and name someone or something
arabicDesc: مثال: هل بإمكانك التعرف على ذلك الرجل بواسطة هذه الصورة؟

paragraph: **Construction** is a hard job. The bridge is under **construction**. A lot of **construction** is going on these days.
english: the process of constructing
arabicDesc: مثال: البناء مهنة صعبة.

paragraph: Don't **waste** your money by buying things you don't need. Let's not **waste** time arguing about it. You're **wasting** your time looking at his picture all day.
english: to use more than needed or use badly; things thrown away
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تبذر مالك في شراء أشياء لست بحاجة إليها.

paragraph: One more step and I'll **blow** your head off. This is going to **blow** up in your face. He struck me a heavy **blow** in the face.
english: to produce an air current

other.meaning: An instance of the act of striking or hitting (noun)

paragraph: Will the justice system face challenges in this **trial**? Their first fall there was a **trial** for them. He was taken to the United States for **trial**.
english: an occasion on which a person or thing is tested to find out how well they perform or how suitable they are
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: محاولة

other.meaning: meeting in a court of law

paragraph: The heavy rain **prevented** us from going fishing. Are you **preventing** me from smoking here? The real issue is how to **prevent** the disease.
english: to keep from happening — see also forestall, avert, ward off, impede
arabicDesc: مثال: منعنا المطر الغزير من الذهاب للصيد.

paragraph: The house standing on the **hill** is very old. It's as old as the **hills**. How about walking to the top of the **hill**?
english: elevated location
arabicDesc: مثال: المنزل الواقف على التلة قديم جداً.

paragraph: I **expressed** a warm thanks. Let's take the **express** train. We'll get there sooner. A letter is the best way to **express** love.
english: to convey meaning
arabicDesc: مثال: عبرت عن شكرٍ جزيلٍ.

paragraph: At least they should have a **map**. Take a look at this **map**. You'll find this **map** very useful.
english: visual representation of an area
arabicDesc: مثال: ينبغي -على الأقل- أن تكون معهم خريطة.

paragraph: When the going gets weird, the weird turn **pro**. You can't do something like that unless you're a **pro**. Do you do it as a **pro**?
english: in favor of

paragraph: Life in prison is a **slow** death. They aren't as **slow** as they used to be. It's a little **slow**. Could you wait a bit?
english: not quick in motion
arabicDesc: مثال: الحياة في السّجن موت بطيء.

other.meaning: To make (something) run, move, etc. less quickly (verb)

paragraph: She has always dressed and identified as a **male**. Although he's a **male**, he feels like a lady. I own three dogs. One **male** and two female.
english: belonging to the sex which typically produces sperm, or to the gender which is typically associated with it

other.meaning: One of the male (masculine) sex or gender (noun)

paragraph: **Dad** is in the kitchen because he's cooking. He went instead of his **dad**. What has gotten into your **dad**?
english: familiar address of one's own father
arabicDesc: مثال: أبي في المطبخ لأنه يطبخ.

paragraph: How do you get kids interested in personal **safety**? Take these **safety** measures when the water level rises. Children in the town were taken away for **safety**.
english: the condition or feeling of being safe
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: أمان، سلامة

paragraph: Why is it so difficult to **connect** with people? It's important to help parents **connect** with their children. It's easy to **connect** with people similar to you.
english: to join (to another object): to attach, or to be intended to attach or capable of attaching, to another object

paragraph: Without a **doubt**, you're the best player on the team. There is no **doubt** as to her beauty. If you're going to **doubt** everything, at least **doubt** your **doubt**.
english: to lack confidence in
arabicDesc: مثال: بدون أي شك, أنت اللاعب الأفضل في الفريق.

paragraph: When was the last time you accepted a **gift**? I want to buy a **gift** for you. I'm looking for a **gift** for my father.
english: something given to another voluntarily, without charge
arabicDesc: مثال: متى كانت آخر مرة قبلت فيها هدية؟

other.meaning: To give as a gift or donation (verb)

paragraph: This **theory** consists of three parts. We are looking for **theories** with scientific grounds. Further study will prove that the **theory** is right.
english: a coherent set of statements attempting to explain observed phenomena
arabicDesc: مثال: تتألف هذه النظرية من ثلاثة أجزاء.

paragraph: His father is a bus **driver**. We have a new bus **driver**. **Drivers** should be aware of the traffic rules.
english: one who drives something, e.g. cattle
arabicDesc: مثال: أبوه سائق حافلة.

other.meaning: person who drives a motorized vehicle, such as a car or a bus

paragraph: My **leg** was broken in a traffic accident. My **legs** hurt after the long walk. You experienced a pain in your **leg**, didn't you?
english: lower limb from groin to ankle
arabicDesc: مثال: كسرت رجلي في حادث مرور.

paragraph: These two **factors** are independent of each other. The main risk **factor** for heart disease is smoking. Ability is the only **factor** considered in promoting employees.
english: integral part
arabicDesc: مثال: هذان العنصران مستقلان عن بعضهما.

paragraph: I'm so excited. We're going to the **beach** today. He likes to go to the **beach** now and then. It's been forever since I didn't go to the **beach**.
english: sandy shore
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا متحمّس جدّا. نحن ذاهبون إلى الشّاطئ اليوم.

paragraph: The **secretary** is tired of typing. My sister works in a bank as a **secretary**. The **secretary** is in a meeting with the director.
english: person keeping records and handling clerical work
arabicDesc: مثال: السكرتيرة متعبة من الطباعة.

paragraph: The hospital had a grand **opening** last month. Excuse me for **opening** your letter by mistake. Any play **opening** to bad reviews won't last long.
english: the start of something; also a hole or space
arabicDesc: مثال: افتُتحت المستشفى الشهر الماضي.

paragraph: He has no less than three **hundred** books. I can count to a **hundred**. He earns more than five **hundred** dollars a month in that job.
english: cardinal number 100
arabicDesc: مثال: لديه ما لا يقل عن ثلاثمئة كتاب.

paragraph: The building **replaced** several houses. I look around but it's you I can't **replace**. Do you think that it's time to **replace** it?
english: to supply or substitute an equivalent for
arabicDesc: مثال: حلّت تلك العمارة محلّ العديد من المنازل.

paragraph: The trouble lay in the **engine**. When was the last time you cut the **engine**? Something is wrong with the **engine** of my car.
english: mechanical device
arabicDesc: مثال: تكمن المشكلة في المحرك.

paragraph: I'll try to **shape** my ideas into a book. The earth is the **shape** of an orange. You're in better **shape** than I am.
english: appearance or outline
arabicDesc: مثال: سأحاول وضع أفكاري في كتاب.

paragraph: They were in the office, doing the **regular** clean. Remember, it's important to take **regular** breaks from screens. He has lost his **regular** place in the team.
english: having a constant pattern

paragraph: If I get **rich**, I will buy it. She will get married to a **rich** man. I believe he is going to be **rich** one day.
english: having wealth
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا لو أصبحت غنياً, سوف أشتريه.

paragraph: I will **transfer** the money. Death is a kind of **transfer** as it were. Language **transfer** influences the learning of a new language.
english: to move or pass from one place, person or thing to another
arabicDesc: مثال: سأُحوّل المبلغ.

other.meaning: The act of conveying or removing something from one place, person or thing to another (noun)

paragraph: You're **definitely** the best player on the team. I can **definitely** do that better than you can. This is **definitely** a movie that you should watch.
english: certainly; without any doubt
arabicDesc: مثال: أنت حتماً اللاعب الأفضل في الفريق.

paragraph: I usually go to school from Monday to **Friday**. Do you remember what you did last **Friday**? Yes, the milk will last till **Friday**.
english: day of the week
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا عادة ما أذهب للمدرسة من الإثنين إلى الجمعة.

paragraph: A people without **knowledge** is a people without strength. A little **knowledge** can be a dangerous thing. Share your **knowledge** with others.
english: fact of knowing about something; understanding, familiarity with information
arabicDesc: مثال: مَن لا معرفة لديه لا قوة له.

other.meaning: awareness, state of having been informed

paragraph: You don't **particularly** want to do that, do you? I don't **particularly** want to be here at all. This is a drink I don't **particularly** care for.
english: especially

paragraph: **Wow**! Look at that good-looking girl over there. Oh **wow**! What's this, you're having lunch without me! **Wow**. The stars are so beautiful out here.
english: an indication of excitement, surprise, astonishment, or pleasure

paragraph: I stole your **bag** because I ran out of money. What do you have in your **bag**? If I had had enough money, I would have bought the **bag**.
english: flexible container
arabicDesc: مثال: سرقْتُ حقيبتك لأنني نفذتُ من النقود

other.meaning: paper (or plastic) container given or sold to shoppers

paragraph: If you don't **jump**, you'll be stuck there. He can **jump** higher than me. This dog can **jump** very high.
english: to propel oneself rapidly upward, downward and/or in any horizontal direction such that momentum causes the body to become airborne
arabicDesc: مثال: إن لم تقفز، فستبقى عالقا هناك.

paragraph: Do you mind if I **smoke** here? Where is all this **smoke** coming from? There is no **smoke** without fire.
english: to give off smoke
arabicDesc: مثال: هل تمانع أن أدخن هنا؟

paragraph: Beauty is but **skin** deep. Don't judge others by the color of their **skin**. This old man has age spots on his **skin**.
english: outer protective layer of the body of a person or animal
arabicDesc: مثال: الجمالُ جمالُ النفسِ.

other.meaning: skin and fur of an animal used by humans
congealed layer on the surface of a liquid

paragraph: Put some more **wood** on the fire. Mrs. **Wood** was a very good cook. He was searching for **wood**.
english: the wood from a particular species of tree
arabicDesc: مثال: زد بعض الحطب إلى النار.

paragraph: The **print** is too small for me to read. The novel had an initial **print** run of 10,000 copies. You didn't read the fine **print**, did you?
english: to produce a copy of a text or image on a surface, especially by machine

paragraph: I looked around for a **weapon** just in case. The best **weapon** against an enemy is another enemy. The man aimed a **weapon** at the police officers.
english: instrument of attack or defense in combat
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: أسلحة

paragraph: Are you a **senior** high school student? It will be great to go to **senior** high. You're a high school **senior** this year, aren't you?
english: older, or higher in rank
arabicDesc: مثال: هل أنت طالب في الثانوية؟

paragraph: The city was **destroyed** by fire. We need to **destroy** everything that belongs to you. Whom the gods would **destroy**, they first make mad.
english: to damage beyond use or repair
arabicDesc: مثال: دمر الحريق المدينة.

paragraph: I don't have a red **cent** to my name. He makes five per **cent** on what he sells. I don't have a **cent**, let alone a dollar.
english: a subunit of currency equal to one-hundredth of the main unit of currency in many countries. Symbol: ¢

paragraph: Which book has had the greatest **influence** on you? Children are open to the **influence** of the streets. I don't want to **influence** you in any way.
english: power to affect, control or manipulate
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: نفوذ

other.meaning: To have an effect on by using gentle or subtle action (verb)

paragraph: I was the first to **discover** what had occurred. **Discover** all the services and advantages of first class. Each day, I **discover** something new about life.
english: find something for the first time

paragraph: It is said that she is a good **cook**. I did not know that you could **cook** so well. My husband is a very good **cook**.
english: to prepare food for eating
arabicDesc: مثال: يقال انها طباخة ماهرة.

paragraph: Good morning. It's time to **wake** up. What time do you usually **wake** up? I didn't want to **wake** you.
english: to stop sleeping
arabicDesc: مثال: صباح الخير. إنهُ وقت الإستيقاظ.

paragraph: That's very **sweet** of you. She is a **sweet** teacher. Good night and **sweet** dreams.
english: having a pleasant taste
arabicDesc: مثال: هذا لطف منك.

other.meaning: The basic taste sensation induced by sugar (noun)

paragraph: The man who throws the furthest will be the **winner**. The **winner** will be announced in three days. He called out the name of the **winner**.
english: one who has won or often wins
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: فائزة، غالب، غالبة

paragraph: This will be a very dangerous **mission**. How dangerous do you think this **mission** is going to be? He was sent on a special **mission** to Europe.
english: set of tasks that fulfills a purpose
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه ستكون مهمة خطيرة جداً.

paragraph: I didn't **steal** the money. He didn't **steal** that money. It is wrong to **steal**.
english: to illegally take possession of
arabicDesc: مثال: لم أسرق المال.

paragraph: I went to a **commercial** high school. I would never feed my dog **commercial** dog food. His company wants him to do a **commercial**.
english: of or pertaining to commerce
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا ذهبت إلى مدرسة ثانوية تجارية.

paragraph: I don't feel like thinking about **marriage** right now. I don't want our **marriage** to end. She accepted his hand in **marriage**.
english: state of being married
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا لا أرغب في التّفكير في الزّواج الآن.

paragraph: **Generally** speaking, history repeats itself. I **generally** don't worry about these sorts of things. **Generally**, there are many people who visit this area.
english: popularly or widely
arabicDesc: مثال: غالباً ما يعيد التاريخ نفسه.

paragraph: Do you have any family member who knows **German**? If I go to Germany, I will learn **German**. It's time to learn the **German** language.
english: native or inhabitant of Germany; person of German citizenship or nationality
arabicDesc: مثال: هل لديك أشخاص في عائلتك يعرفون الألمانية؟

other.meaning: A number of townships in the United States, listed under German Township (noun)
Of or relating to the nation of Germany (adjective)

paragraph: Do you believe **global** warming is the result of human actions? English is a **global** language. In 2014, **global** sea level was 2.6 inches above the 1993 average.
english: concerning all parts of the world
arabicDesc: مثال: هل تعتقد أن الاحترار العالمي هو نتيجة لعمل البشر؟

paragraph: More students are **interested** in finance than in industry. The youth of our land are not **interested** in politics. That man is still **interested** in you.
english: having or showing interest
arabicDesc: مثال: أغلب الطلبة يهتمون بالمالية أكثر مما يهتمون بالصناعة.

paragraph: **Nobody** can tell you who your father is. I thought there was **nobody** in the kitchen. **Nobody** wants to look for my car.
english: no person
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أحد بإمكانه أن يخبرك من هو ابوك.

paragraph: One **plus** two is equal to three. It's as sure as two **plus** two is four. Speaking French is a big **plus** for this position.
english: with
arabicDesc: مثال: واحد زائد اثنان يساوي ثلاثة.

paragraph: I'll sign this **agreement** when I've looked over it. I'm not trying to back out of that **agreement**. We made an **agreement** to meet exactly at ten.
english: an understanding between entities to follow a specific course of conduct

other.meaning: understanding to follow a course of conduct
state whereby several parties share a view

paragraph: This is the biggest **cat** that I've ever seen. Do you know where she bought herself a **cat**? She never told me she had a **cat**.
english: domestic species
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه أكبر قطة رأيتها في حياتي.

paragraph: His shirt was gray and his **tie** was yellow. Do you know how to **tie** your shoes? She found a nice **tie** for me.
english: to attach or fasten with string
arabicDesc: مثال: كانَ قميصهُ رمادياً وربطةُ عُنقهِ صفراءَ.

paragraph: His father became ill with **cancer**. I thought nothing could be as bad as **cancer**. She must have known that she had a **cancer**.
english: disease of uncontrolled cellular proliferation
arabicDesc: مثال: والده أصبح مريضاً بالسرطان.

other.meaning: A constellation of the zodiac traditionally figured in the shape of a crab (noun)

paragraph: You should plan to come with us the next time we go **camping**. He and I were in the same **camp** then. At the **camp**, it was difficult to see anything.
english: outdoor place
arabicDesc: مثال: يجب عليك أن تُخطط للقدوم معنا المرة المقبلة التي نذهب فيها للتخييم.

paragraph: He's very honest, so we can **depend** on him. Don't **depend** on your parents too much. You **depend** too much on others.
english: to rely on someone or something; to be decided by something
arabicDesc: مثال: إنهُ صادق جداً, لذا يمكننا أن نعتمد عليه.

paragraph: If you bet your horses on **Trump**, you'll lose. I wonder who **Trump** sold the nuclear secrets to. **Trump** says what he means and means what he says.
english: the suit, in a game of cards, that outranks all others

paragraph: What **flight** are you on? It's not easy to prevent white **flight** from cities. Have a good **flight**! Call me when you land!
english: the act of flying
arabicDesc: مثال: في أية رحلة أنت؟

paragraph: That's the **stupidest** thing I've ever said. This is the **stupidest** thing I have ever heard. It's one of the **stupidest** things I've ever done.
english: lacking in intelligence
arabicDesc: مثال: هذا أغبى ما قُلتُه على الإطلاق.

paragraph: There are rules that **limit** our actions in society. Do you know what the speed **limit** is here? He ignored the speed **limit** and drove very fast.
english: restriction; bound beyond which one may not go

paragraph: Are you going to **attend** the meeting? I have to **attend** this class. He didn't **attend** the meeting.
english: (''ambitransitive'') to be present at or regularly go to
arabicDesc: مثال: هل ستحضر الإجتماع؟

paragraph: For future **reference**, I'm going to record this event. This **reference** book is of benefit to you all. I don't have any good **reference** book at hand.
english: a measurement one can compare (some other measurement) to

paragraph: It is possible that you'll win the **competition**. He was lucky and won the **competition**. His **competition** record was the worst among the five.
english: contest for a prize or award
arabicDesc: مثال: من الممكن أن تربح المسابقة.

paragraph: Can you read this **document** for me? They gave you a **document** your dad was supposed to sign, didn't they? The title of the **document** needs to be centered.
english: original or official paper
arabicDesc: مثال: هل يمكنكَ قراءة هذا النص من أجلي

paragraph: The government got their **majority** at the last election. She spends a **majority** of her time helping him. A **majority** of the people here can speak French.
english: more than half
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: غالبية، أكثرية، معظم

paragraph: Why did you leave your job on the **farm**? We all worked together on the **farm**. What do you grow on your **farm**?
english: place where agricultural activities take place
arabicDesc: مثال: لماذا تركت عملك في المزرعة؟

paragraph: Did you **grade** the tests? She got good **grades** in English. I got a good **grade** on my French test.
english: a rating
arabicDesc: مثال: هل صححت الإمتحانات؟

paragraph: Would you be **arrested** if you did that? She was **arrested** by the police. The police **arrested** the suspect yesterday.
english: to take into legal custody
arabicDesc: مثال: هَل سَيتمُّ إعتِقالُكَ إنْ فَعَلتَ ذلِك؟

paragraph: Today we are starting a very big **investment** project. An **investment** in knowledge always pays the best interest. Buying a house has stopped being a good **investment**.
english: the act of investing, or state of being invested

paragraph: Our **professor** paid the bill for all of us. My French **professor** is the same age as me. The **professor** spoke too fast for anyone to understand.
english: the most senior rank for an academic at a university or similar institution
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: معلم

paragraph: Where can I **exchange** money? I wonder if **exchange** students can join this club. In the car, we didn't **exchange** a single word.
english: act of exchanging or trading
arabicDesc: مثال: أين يمكننى تبادل النقود؟

paragraph: A wife can have property **independent** of her husband. This is evidenced by the results of **independent** studies. How many **independent** countries are there in the world?
english: not dependent; not contingent or depending on something else; free
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: حر

paragraph: I have handed your letter over to the **administration**. We need someone who has some experience in **administration**. During his **administration** a great many new laws were passed.
english: the act of administering
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مراقبة

paragraph: The **annual** General Meeting will be held in June. It's time to make out our **annual** report. An average worker gets an **annual** pay rise.
english: happening once every year

paragraph: I told him not to wait for you **anymore**. I don't want you to think about it **anymore**. Why doesn't he send me letters **anymore**?
english: any longer; used in negative sentences
arabicDesc: مثال: قلت له أن يتوقّف عن انتظارك.

paragraph: He has worked in **France** his whole life. I'll go to **France** to study painting. The women of **France** are beautiful.
english: a country located primarily in Western Europe. Official name: French Republic. Capital and largest city: Paris
arabicDesc: مثال: اشتغل في فرنسا طوال حياته.

paragraph: Don't worry. I have **insurance**. The **insurance** contract isn't very clear on this point. Owners of red sports cars pay higher **insurance** rates.
english: a means of indemnity against a future occurrence of an uncertain event
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تقلق. أنا لدي تأمين.

paragraph: When was the last time you had a **physical**? Where you are is not just your **physical** environment. I don't have the **physical** strength to do that.
english: of matter and nature
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: ملموس، محسوس

other.meaning: having to do with the body; corporeal

paragraph: Are you **seriously** thinking about buying that old car? I suggest you take this a little more **seriously**. If everyone likes you, no one takes you **seriously**.
english: in a serious or literal manner
arabicDesc: مثال: هل أنت تفكر جديا في شراء هذه السيارة القديمة؟

paragraph: The new plan has been very **successful**. They were **successful** in solving the problem. So far everything has been **successful**.
english: resulting in success
arabicDesc: مثال: الخِطة الجديدة كانت ناجِحة جداً.

paragraph: We're no longer living in the **stone** age. I have a **stone** in my shoe. Those who live in glass houses should not throw **stones**.
english: a hard earthen substance that can form rocks
arabicDesc: مثال: لم نعد نعيش في العصر الحجري.

paragraph: The **communication** recently has been lost with the team. We need to keep the lines of **communication** open. There should be more **communication** between the persons concerned.
english: the act or fact of communicating anything
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: اتصال

paragraph: Before, he would go to the **firm** on foot. The first time, she wasn't very **firm** with him. We must take a **firm** stand on this matter.
english: a company; also hard and not soft

paragraph: If you want to **extend** your life, stop smoking. Can I **extend** my stay for one more day? Can you **extend** your holiday by a few days?
english: to make longer or bigger

paragraph: Don't forget to put it on your **schedule**. The bus is falling behind **schedule**. Does your **schedule** allow you to have time off?
